title: Your materials become the first path

steps.text: The same eight back slots hold logs and stone. Accepted tree and rock harvests fill them; Local swings and flights never spend or create supply.
The host validates identity, reach and cadence, then durably stores an ordered request before publishing its acceptance.
Both worlds fund stations in order: T1 needs 24 logs; T2 needs 32 logs and 8 stone; T3 needs 40 logs and one beam. Each funded job captures its timing. Retrying cannot spend twice.
Only T3’s accepted 40 logs expose the shared proper axe. Twelve proper hits on the great tree produce one revision-fenced beam. An empty back claims it; optional help never creates another item.
T1 and T2 award separate personal cosmetics under the same atomic profile lock. Existing T1 claims remain valid. Shared axe and optional jump acquisition are world facts, not cosmetic claims.
Owned views rebuild accepted stock, solid track, the completed path’s lamps and commuters quietly. The machine waits by the village; walking home needs no optional jump, forge or train.

After Q5 the server casts one revision-fenced boiler. Its accepted fit enables two train schedules. The line-2 kit moves forge rails and counted depot logs aboard, then unloads atomically at Far Head for Q6; every mirror derives pose from the train row and room tick.
